description: This bar chart illustrates the GLUE performance for different fine-tuning methods with varying RoBERTa model sizes. The horizontal axis represents the fine-tuning method, labeled as “Prefix”, “Adaptor”, “LoRA”, “BitFit”, “S₁-model”, “S₂-model”, and “S₃-model”, in that order, and appears to be categorical with no explicit sorting. The vertical axis, labeled “GLUE Performance”, represents a linear scale ranging from approximately 84 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 2. Two bars are displayed for each fine-tuning method, representing “base” and “large” RoBERTa model sizes, indicated by blue and brown colors respectively. For the “Prefix” method, the “base” model achieves a performance of approximately 85.2, while the “large” model reaches approximately 87.6. The “Adaptor” method shows a “base” performance of around 87.4 and a “large” performance of approximately 88.2. The “LoRA” method has “base” and “large” performances of about 86.8 and 89.2, respectively. For “BitFit”, the “base” and “large” models achieve approximately 86.4 and 87.8. The “S₁-model” displays “base” and “large” performances of roughly 85.8 and 88.6. The “S₂-model” shows “base” and “large” performances of approximately 86.2 and 89. The “S₃-model” has “base” and “large” performances of about 86.6 and 89.4. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
